_doctrine: R-023: the baseline contract. Deck 1 BEATS = what a PLAIN tutorial on this concept would minimally need (derived from the concept, not the inventory); each beat is a ROLE cast with one artifact (alts = understudies). Deck 2 VOLTAGE = the few pieces a plain tutorial would never include -- the critical script, the thinker with QFEP. Everything uncast is AT DEPTH: kept, honored by the dig line, not needed by the book or the walk.

voltage.why: oscillation as the body's rhythm — the swing that never stops, the room turning under a fixed plane; motion as the ground's own pulse
F <-> E as the queer exchange — force and energy trading places forever, tension that resolves only by relaxing; consonance as bodies finding rest in each other
interference as the meeting of two histories — where two waves cross, addition writes a third pattern neither carried alone; the meeting is the message
standing wave as fixed identity — the frozen wave you walk through, wavelength made architecture; the pattern that holds still while you move
oscillation become visible trace — the pendulum paints its own decay, motion leaving a biography; the swing that writes itself down
